# Result: I cannot compute this figure

The embedded-emissions figure for this shipment can't be computed from the supplied ruleset and factor table. Per the ruleset, if a required input is missing or not in the table, no estimate is made.

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | CN 7202 41 (ferro-chromium, > 4% carbon) | ❌ **Not in the table.** The table covers only 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90 and 7214 20 00. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | India | ❌ **No listing.** India appears for other CN codes, but no (7202 41, India) combination exists. |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 700 t | ✅ Provided |

## Missing input

- **The default SEE (tCO2e/t) for CN 7202 41 (ferro-chromium, > 4% C) produced in India.** It must be added to the factor table before the calculation can proceed.

## Why no proxy factor was used

Default values are selected jointly by CN code and country. Substituting a factor from another good, such as the India value for pig iron (CN 7201, 2.53 tCO2e/t), would be an estimate. The ruleset prohibits that. Ferro-chromium is also a different product with a different production route, so any such proxy would be unsupported.

## Once the factor is supplied

Embedded emissions (tCO2e) = SEE(7202 41, India) × 700 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
